name: The Eastern Pylon
label: Quest
description: The Eastern Pylon: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: During my stay here, I have heard strange rumors about mysterious pylons existing out in the wilderness of the crater, friend. I guess that they are quite large, with crystals lining their interiors.
Although I've never seen one, I can't help but think that the rumors are true -- and that the pylons have something to do with all the crystals we found
So why don't you help me put my curiosity to rest? Supposedly, there is one in the eastern area of the crater. Do you think you can find it?

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you visited the pylon, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Un'Goro is such a strange place, friend. When you enter the crater, it's as if you are in a completely different world...
